Name: Zedekiah, Son of Maaseiah
Summary: Zedekiah, son of Maaseiah, was a false prophet among the exiles in Babylon whom Jeremiah denounced alongside Ahab son of Kolaiah; Jeremiah foretold that Nebuchadnezzar would roast them in the fire. He is a different man from Zedekiah the king.
KeyStory: Jeremiah told the exiles that Zedekiah son of Maaseiah and Ahab son of Kolaiah, who prophesied lies, would become a curse and a byword.
RelatedPeople: Ahab, Son of Kolaiah; Jeremiah; King Nebuchadnezzar
LifeLesson: A shared lie does not halve the guilt — both prophets were named.
